cards.ex: The antique was advertised as the 'genuine article', but experts later proved it was a fake.
cards.exUz: Antikvar buyum 'haqiqiy narsa' deb reklama qilingan edi, lekin keyinchalik mutaxassislar uning soxta ekanligini isbotladilar.
cards.uzDef: Soxta emas, chinakam, haqiqiy narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: He wasn't lying exactly, but he was certainly economical with the truth in his job application.
cards.exUz: U aniq yolg'on gapirmadi, lekin ishga ariza berishda rostni tejagan edi.
cards.uzDef: Rost gapirmaslik, lekin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yolg'on gapirmaslik.

cards.ex: Truth be told, I never really liked that painting.
cards.exUz: Rostini aytsam, menga bu rasm hech qachon yoqmagan.
cards.uzDef: Agar rostini aytsam, ochig'ini aytsam.

cards.ex: Many customers were duped into believing the product would cure all their ailments.
cards.exUz: Ko'p mijozlar mahsulot ularning barcha dardlariga davo bo'lishiga ishontirib aldanib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Yolg'on gapirib yoki xatosini ko'rsatmay, bir narsaga ishontirish.

cards.ex: He took me for a ride when he sold me that broken car.
cards.exUz: U menga buzilgan mashinani sotib, meni aldab ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir aldash, foydalanish yoki xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: The reporter promised to present the unvarnished truth about the scandal.
cards.exUz: Reportyor mojaro haqida ochiq haqiqatni taqdim etishga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday yashirin narsasiz, to'liq va to'g'ri haqiqat.

cards.ex: He stole the money in broad daylight, with everyone watching.
cards.exUz: U pulni kunduz kuni, hamma ko'rib turgan paytda o'g'irladi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga, hech qanday yashirin narsasiz.

cards.ex: The company was fined for its deceptive practices in advertising.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya reklamadagi aldov amaliyotlari uchun jarimaga tortildi.
cards.uzDef: Aldash yoki yolg'on ma'lumot berish orqali odamlarni chalg'itadigan usullar.

cards.ex: His decision to accept the bribe became a question of integrity.
cards.exUz: Uning pora olish qarori halollik masalasiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining halolligi yoki axloqiy tamoyillari shubha ostida bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: He gained access to the building under false pretenses, claiming to be a repairman.
cards.exUz: U bino ichiga soxta bahonalar bilan, o'zini ta'mirlovchi deb tanishtirib kirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yolg'on bahonalar bilan, aldash orqali.

cards.ex: The accountant was accused of fudging the figures to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Buxgalter soliq to'lamaslik uchun raqamlarni soxtalashtirishda ayblandi.
cards.uzDef: Raqamlarni soxtalashtirish, yolg'on ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: The author took liberties with the historical facts in his novel.
cards.exUz: Yozuvchi o'z romanida tarixiy faktlar bilan erkinlikni suiiste'mol qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ruxsat etilmagan narsani qilish, faktlarni buzish.

cards.ex: She testified on oath that she had seen the defendant at the scene of the crime.
cards.exUz: U jinoyat joyida ayblanuvchini ko'rganini qasamyod ostida guvohlik berdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda haqiqatni gapirishga qasamyod qilgan holda.

cards.ex: To the best of my knowledge, the information I provided is accurate.
cards.exUz: Bilishimcha, men taqdim etgan ma'lumotlar aniq.
cards.term: to the best of my knowledge
cards.uzDef: Men bilganimcha, men bilgan eng yaxshi darajada.

cards.ex: I swear to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth.
cards.exUz: Men haqiqatni, butun haqiqatni va faqat haqiqatni gapirishga qasamyod qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Faqat haqiqatni gapirish, yolg'on gapirmaslik.

cards.ex: He tried to pull the wool over my eyes, but I knew he was lying.
cards.exUz: U mening ko'zimni bo'yamoqchi bo'ldi, lekin men uning yolg'on gapirayotganini bildim.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir aldash yoki chalg'itish.

cards.ex: The advertisement contained misleading information about the product's capabilities.
cards.exUz: Reklama mahsulotning imkoniyatlari haqida chalg'ituvchi ma'lumotlarni o'z ichiga olgan.
cards.uzDef: To'liq bo'lmagan yoki noto'g'ri ma'lumot beradigan, odamlarni chalg'itadigan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: The politician was accused of misrepresenting the facts to gain public support.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi xalq qo'llab-quvvatlashiga erishish uchun faktlarni noto'g'ri ko'rsatishda ayblandi.
cards.uzDef: Faktlarni noto'g'ri taqdim etish, yolg'on ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: It was a blatant lie, and everyone knew it.
cards.exUz: Bu ochiq yolg'on edi va buni hamma bilardi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va uyatli yolg'on.

cards.ex: The crime was committed with malice aforethought.
cards.exUz: Jinoyat oldindan yomon niyat bilan sodir etilgan.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirilgan va yomon niyat bilan.

cards.ex: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the meeting.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilishga kechikkanligi uchun bahona to'qishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Bahona to'qish, o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: He decided to come clean about his past mistakes.
cards.exUz: U o'zining o'tmishdagi xatoliklari haqida tan olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida haqiqatni aytish, tan olmoq.

cards.ex: The report doesn't hold any punches, it clearly outlines the problems.
cards.exUz: Hisobot hech narsani yashirmaydi, unda muammolar aniq ko'rsatilgan.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va to'g'ri gapirish, yashirmaslik.

cards.ex: The donation was just a fig leaf to cover up their environmental damage.
cards.exUz: Bu xayriya ularning atrof-muhitga yetkazgan zararini yashirish uchun shunchaki yuzaki bahona edi.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy muammoni yashirish uchun ishlatiladigan yuzaki bahona.

cards.ex: Her honesty and integrity are beyond reproach.
cards.exUz: Uning halolligi va vijdonliligi tanqidga loyiq emas.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday ayb topib bo'lmaydigan, benuqson.

cards.ex: You can trust him, he's a straight shooter.
cards.exUz: Unga ishonishingiz mumkin, u to'g'ri so'z odam.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni ochiq va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapiradigan odam.

cards.ex: She hides behind a facade of confidence, but inside she's very insecure.
cards.exUz: U o'zining haqiqiy his-tuyg'ularini yashirish uchun ishonch niqobi ortiga yashirinadi, lekin ichida juda ishonchsiz.
cards.uzDef: O'zining haqiqiy his-tuyg'ularini yoki niyatlarini yashirish.

cards.ex: She may seem pure as the driven snow, but don't be fooled.
cards.exUz: U qordek oppoq bo'lib ko'rinishi mumkin, lekin aldanishga yo'l qo'ymang.
cards.uzDef: Benazir va toza, begunoh.

cards.ex: Once he paid off his debts, he was finally in the clear.
cards.exUz: U qarzlarini to'lagandan so'ng, nihoyat toza edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday ayblovlarsiz, xavf-xatarsiz.

cards.ex: The monster under the bed was just a figment of his imagination.
cards.exUz: Krovat ostidagi maxluq shunchaki uning xayoliy narsasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat xayolda mavjud bo'lgan narsa, haqiqat emas.
